input.rationale: Section 4(c) is the only effects-of-termination provision and it addresses solely cessation of the Services, revocation of the licence, Customer's cessation of use and mutual return/destruction of Confidential Information. There is no transition-assistance, data return/export or certified-deletion obligation anywhere in the Agreement (no hits for transition, export, wind-down or machine-readable), even though Kubient collects, maintains and stores AP data and Requests on AP's behalf (Section 4(c)(iv), p0035). That falls short of both the preferred position (six months' assistance, 30-day machine-readable return, certified deletion) and the fallback (90 days' assistance, 30-day export), and the bare "return or destroy" option for Confidential Information risks the walk-away outcome of deletion without return. Inserted the model transition and data-return language into Section 4(c) as items (v)-(vii).

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion obligations into Section 4(c)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4(c) only stops the Services and addresses Confidential Information, so we have added transition assistance and return of our data on exit. Our playbook requires up to six months of transition help at Kubient's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance if that is easier for Kubient.

ops.text: (v) at Customer's request, Kubient will provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following expiration or termination at Kubient's then-current rates; (vi) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, Kubient will return to Customer all Customer data then in Kubient's possession or control, including Requests, Content and all data collected, generated, maintained or stored by Kubient on Customer's behalf, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (vii) thereafter Kubient will delete such data from its systems and, upon request, certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
